proposition: According to Melvin-Koushki, John Cooper, relying largely on the Tamhid, describes Ibn Turka as one of the first to unify the Peripatetic, ishraqi and Akbarian strands in a Shiʿi-esotericist perspective and as learned in numerical symbolism.

mediation.note: The position is this scholar's own; we have it only as summarised by Melvin-Koushki.
MK argues a rival reading (Ibn Turka as occult philosopher) and in places calls this reading an error; his summary may compress or foreshorten it.
